messages:
sam: heads-up: deploybot blocked a publish for billing-worker:v2.7.1. flagged provenance mismatch between gcr and ecr mirrors.

deploybot: publish blocked for image `billing-worker:v2.7.1` 
reason: cosign attestation digest differs across registries (gcr.io/redwood/billing-worker vs registry.redwood.io/billing-worker). automatic promote skipped to avoid cross-registry provenance ambiguity.

lara: any quick details on the mismatch? new cosign key rotated recently?

deploybot: attestation metadata: gcr attestation signed with key ID K1234, ecr attestation signed with key ID K1234 but recorded manifest digest differs (sha256:aa11... vs sha256:bb22...). possible push-without-rewrite on mirror.

ryan: if the manifest digest changed during mirror copy we shouldn't re-sign in staging. we should copy the exact digest we intend to serve and pin by digest.

nina: agree. recommended flow: copy by digest to a staging-qualified repo and set deploy pin. use gcrane/skopeo to avoid re-writing layers.

ops: proposed commands to run during a short change window (verify before running):
```
# fetch canonical digest from source registry
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/billing-worker:v2.7.1 --format='get(image_summary.digest)'
# copy by digest to staging repo without modifying manifests
skopeo copy \
  docker://gcr.io/redwood/billing-worker@sha256:aa11... \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/billing-worker:promote-1768943210 --preserve-digests
# set deploybot pin to digest
deploybot set-pin --service=billing-worker --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/billing-worker@sha256:aa11...
```

lara: good. add an extra verification: cosign verify-attestation against the copied digest before pinning.

ryan: rollback plan: if staging errors >4% or build of canary fails, revert deploybot pin to previous digest and delete the staging tag. keep a 15-min change window at 02:30 UTC tomorrow.

nina: I'll open a PR with the exact commands + tiny revert script and release-note blurb explaining the provenance reasoning.

qa-bot: automated tests will run after pin. please include test matrix tag `staging-provenance-check`.

sam: add a follow-up ticket to detect mirror-copies that rewrite manifest digests and mark copy jobs as "rewrite-unsafe". we keep hitting these silent rewrites.

ops: noted; filing ticket now.

lara: ping me and @ryan when the PR is ready. I'll approve and run during the 02:30 UTC window.

sam: thanks everyone. action items: nina PR + verification steps + 02:30 change window + ops ticket. :thumbsup:

nina: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/1436 10 includes promote by digest, cosign verify, and revert script. tagging @lara @ryan @ops

sam: will run the promote during window and post result here.
